rescued.notes: 123 cores reviewed from _uncategorized.json (cores that keyword-matched no category). As expected the bundle is overwhelmingly off-mission noise: US/foreign tax (state income tax, SALT, Thailand/Philippines/Latvia/Lithuania, generation-skipping, documentary stamp), corporation/VAT/income/personal tax for general businesses, bookkeeping/accounting-practice services, US-county property-tax/transfer-tax/lease-law sets, real-estate listings/jobs/REIT-dividend/court-case dumps, programmatic templated junk (corporation-tax-return-N, capital-taxes-N, incorporate-company-X.htm, lease.htm, ofw-home-loan), control-systems/partnership-accounting homework, and lead-gen city-page sprawl. Only a handful of cores touch genuine UK property-tax/landlord intent, and every one of those is already covered by live pages except a marginal leasehold concept (ground rent).

topics.topic_title: Rent a Room Scheme - GBP 7,500 tax-free income
topics.suggested_angle: Live page already covers the GBP 7,500 allowance, lodger/short-let mechanics and tax treatment. No new page needed.

topics.suggested_angle: Deep HMO cluster already live (8+ pages incl. tax, accounting, licensing, incorporation). Investing-angle queries served by existing comparison and tax guides.

topics.suggested_angle: ROE / overseas-entity disclosure already covered for non-resident landlords incl. annual update statement and public-register expansion.

topics.topic_title: When overseas companies must register at Companies House (overseas property register)
topics.suggested_angle: On-mission slice (overseas property register) overlaps ROE coverage; remainder of the core is generic company-registration noise. No new page.

topics.topic_title: What is ground rent (leasehold ground rent / peppercorn / service charges)
topics.suggested_angle: No dedicated 'what is ground rent' page. Marginal: primarily a leasehold/conveyancing concept with only a thin landlord deductibility/peppercorn-reform tax angle. If pursued, fold a landlord-facing ground-rent + service-charge tax-treatment section into existing leasehold-reform coverage rather than a standalone page. Low value.
